title: Formal Lean Proof of the Irrationality of Catalan’s Constant G
aiSystem: OpenAI Internal Frontier Math Model + Lean 4
whyItMatters: Resolves the 161-year-old question of whether Catalan’s constant G = Σ (-1)^k/(2k+1)² is irrational via a Lean-formalized determinant proof—a flagship target on Epoch AI’s FrontierMath: Open Problems.
summary: Dated September 24 and published on October 6, 2026 as Family 005 of OpenAI’s mathematical release, an unreleased internal OpenAI model produced a manuscript and Lean 4 formalization proving that Catalan’s constant G = β(2) = 1 − 1/3² + 1/5² − 1/7² + ··· is irrational, using a sophisticated determinant method rather than classical Apéry linear recurrences. Epoch AI’s FrontierMath: Open Problems explicitly logged the result as resolving a second headline target of its “Apéry-Style Irrationality Proofs” breakthrough challenge (after ζ(5)), and follow-up work quickly extracted an explicit irrationality measure (Hexagon Math 2610.00187).
technicalHighlights: Establishes the irrationality of Catalan’s constant G = β(2) with an accompanying Lean 4 formalization (OpenAI Family 005).
Uses an advanced determinant-method construction bypassing the longstanding convergence obstruction of classical Apéry-style Padé approximants.
Recorded by Epoch AI as resolving a second target of its Breakthrough-tier FrontierMath: Open Problems irrationality challenge and extended to an irrationality measure within days.
caveats: Part of OpenAI’s unrefereed October 6 bulk release; while backed by a Lean 4 formalization and rapidly built upon by independent follow-up preprints, full journal peer review and community definition audits remain underway.

scoreRationale.foundational: Settles one of the most famous unresolved irrationality problems in number theory since Eugène Catalan introduced G in 1865.
scoreRationale.ripple: Demonstrates determinant-method machinery applicable to Dirichlet L-values and prompted immediate quantitative irrationality-measure extensions.
scoreRationale.verification: Accompanied by a Lean 4 formalization and recognized by Epoch AI’s FrontierMath: Open Problems tracker, docked slightly pending full peer review.
scoreRationale.velocity: Resolved autonomously in a single frontier compute sweep alongside ζ(5) and other classical constants.
